methodology_note: All 45 items are real collected Federal Reserve RSS items from ml/data/fed_news.json. No synthetic developer-written sentences are treated as ground truth, and no language model was trained from scratch. The held_out_manual_audit split (23 real items) provides objective human-auditable labels for RSS headlines/metadata; the remaining 22 items remain tagged PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW. Note that Fed RSS items contain headlines/venues rather than full FOMC/BLS statement bodies, so honest directional policy/XAUUSD ground truth on headline-only items is NEUTRAL (insufficient detail).
